reasons.persona_fit: Directly targets small business owner-operators in Bareni's calm, practical voice while strictly respecting all boundaries and the no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: Logical, concise, and immediately understandable, clearly defining the operational tradeoff and scope without unnecessary jargon.
reasons.actionability: Provides a feasible, concrete step to sample records and establish review thresholds before deciding on automation boundaries.
reasons.factual_grounding: Fully grounded in approved principles; invents no customer data or capabilities and reinforces mandatory human approval for money movement.
